definitions.explanation: Arts performed before an audience, including music, dance, theater, and other entertainment.

notes:
{芸能|げいのう} encompasses both traditional and modern performing arts and entertainment.

Traditional {芸能|げいのう}:
- {歌舞伎|かぶき} (Kabuki theater)
- {能|のう} (Noh theater)
- {落語|らくご} (comic storytelling)
- {雅楽|ががく} (court music)

Modern {芸能|げいのう}:
- Music, comedy, TV entertainment
- {芸能|げいのう}{界|かい} (entertainment industry/world)
- {芸能|げいのう}{人|じん} (entertainer, celebrity)

Common collocations:
- {芸能|げいのう}{界|かい} (entertainment world/industry)
- {芸能|げいのう}{人|じん} (entertainer)
- {芸能|げいのう}ニュース (entertainment news)
- {伝統|でんとう}{芸能|げいのう} (traditional performing arts)
